title: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: It replaces generic, per-generator KV-cache eviction in agentic autoregressive video generation with training-free top-k retention scored by planner-extracted semantic constraints via text cross-attention. It costs group-wise attention scoring and selection overhead per candidate while leaving keys, values, and positions unchanged, with reported quality essentially at Full KV level. It can fail when text cross-attention misidentifies constraint-relevant positions, when workloads lack explicit planner constraints, or when results on the four evaluated backbones do not transfer to the reader's stack.
rationale: The memory and speed gains are compelling and require no retraining, but adoption is premature because the method targets agentic AR video pipelines and specific backbones that the reader likely does not operate, so it warrants monitoring until applicability to their workload is confirmed.
technique: Semantically guided KV cache compression for AR video

claims.statement: It replaces generic, per-generator KV-cache eviction in agentic autoregressive video generation with training-free top-k retention scored by planner-extracted semantic constraints via text cross-attention. It costs group-wise attention scoring and selection overhead per candidate while leaving keys, values, and positions unchanged, with reported quality essentially at Full KV level. It can fail when text cross-attention misidentifies constraint-relevant positions, when workloads lack explicit planner constraints, or when results on the four evaluated backbones do not transfer to the reader's stack.

On Causal Forcing at compression ratio 0.7, SemanticKV reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB (3.35x), achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV, and scores VBench Total 84.10 versus 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV.
